# Locally served notation dependencies

- OpenSheetMusicDisplay 2.2.0, downloaded from the official npm package `opensheetmusicdisplay`. MIT license: `OSMD-LICENSE.txt`. Source: https://github.com/opensheetmusicdisplay/opensheetmusicdisplay
- fflate 0.8.3, downloaded from the official npm package `fflate`. MIT license: `FFLATE-LICENSE.txt`. Source: https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate

Only the self-service import workflow loads these files. Visitors' MusicXML and MIDI are parsed locally; no third-party CDN is needed for notation rendering or compressed-score reading.
